name: Atlas Precision Inc
old_description: Since 1979, Atlas Precision Plastics has been committed to providing high-quality, cost-effective, plastic injection molding
about:
Atlas Precision Inc. traces its roots to April 1979, when Johann W. Hofschuster founded Atlas Mold Inc. in Arden, North Carolina, to design and build injection molds. In 1988 the company added a custom molding division, Atlas Precision Plastics, and installed its first molding machines the following year. The two operations were combined under one roof in 2006, and the business has remained under Hofschuster's leadership as president and chief executive.

Today the firm operates as a full-service injection molder with 33 presses ranging from 80 to 360 tons, each equipped with a robot or sprue picker. The production floor runs 24/7 across four crews, supported by an on-site toolroom that designs, builds, and maintains multi-cavity tooling, including core-pull, unscrewing, overmolding, and hot-runner systems. A quality lab and RJG/eDart process monitoring complement the molding operation, while 3D printing provides prototype parts. The company works with engineered resins and wood-composite materials.

Atlas serves the healthcare, automotive, telecommunications, industrial, and electrical markets, producing components for medical devices, electrical connectors, packaging, and single-use consumer products. Long-standing customers include Johnson & Johnson (Personal Care and Vistakon divisions), S.C. Johnson, Bic Corporation, Robert Bosch Automotive, Tyco Electronics, and Trex.

The company emphasizes a one-stop-shop model, assigning each customer a dedicated account manager who coordinates design, tooling, molding, and packaging. Hofschuster's team highlights its reputation for building fast-cycling, low-maintenance tooling and holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, CSA International, and UL certifications.
